title: Build One Fictional Phone Field
label: ch:pa-form-phone-runway
canDo: I can recognise the Gurmukhi phone label and independently select and write one of two taught fictional phone values digit by digit from a nonverbal cue.

payoff.summary: The learner fills one fictional phone line from a remembered nonverbal cue with no romanization, Latin digits, or copyable Gurmukhi answer, then checks selection, six digit positions, grouping, and placement separately.
